Nothing of use left for either of us to do here.''"<br />"''I'm staying. It's not entirely dead here yet, and I'd like to conduct research.|B-7G2 and HMC-10|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''B-7G2''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who was designed for research in the biological sciences, and was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Invasion of Ziost]] in the [[Galactic War]]. B-7G2 and another droid, [[HMC-10]], were evacuated from the planet prior to [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] wiping out of all life on the world, and when they returned to the now-desolate surface, B-7G2 decided to remain behind and conduct research.

==Behind the scenes==
B-7G2 was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an ambient character on Ziost in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor,<ref name="TOR" /> which was released on [[April 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/4282015/game-update-3.2-rise-emperor|text=Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor Patch Notes}}</ref>
